author: Jasmin Chavez
title: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Has Filed Its Formal Opposition Against A New Bill The “Assistance and Access Bill 2018”
text:
Locations October 14, 2018 Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Has Filed Its Formal Opposition Against A New Bill The “Assistance and Access Bill 2018”
The California Company said in a filing, on Friday provided to reporters, that the proposal was flawed, as Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has filed its formal opposition towards a new bill the “Assistance and Access Bill 2018” , currently being proposed by the Australian government, that critics of bill has a stance on it, that it would weaken the encryption.
The “Assistance and Access Bill 2018” would create a new type of warrant, if it get approval, then that would allow what governments often call the lawful access to thwart encryption, that is something that the former Australian attorney general also proposed in last year.
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) took direct aim, the “going dark” problem, what American authorities have called it, it’s a view that the strong encryption makes it far too difficult for the law enforcement agencies to access hardened devices.
The company wrote, “This is no time to weaken encryption,”“There is profound risk of making criminals’ jobs easier, not harder. Increasingly stronger not weaker encryption is the best way to protect against these threats.”
“Some suggest that exceptions can be made, and access to encrypted data could be created just for only those sworn to uphold the public good,” Apple continued. “That is a false premise. Encryption is simply math. Any process that weakens the mathematical models that protect user data for anyone will by extension weaken the protections for everyone. It would be wrong to weaken security for millions of law-abiding customers in order to investigate the very few who pose a threat.” About Jasmin Chavez
